# Attribution and licensing notice

The guidance in this skill is derived from *Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software
Craftsmanship* by Robert C. Martin (Prentice Hall, 2008). The rules, smell identifiers
(F1–F4, G5–G36, N1–N7, T1–T9), and worked examples originate with that book.

This skill contains restatements of those rules written for agent consumption, not
reproductions of the book's text. Before publishing this repository publicly or
distributing the skill outside your organization, review whether that use is
appropriate for your situation.

Set the `license` field in `SKILL.md` frontmatter to a specific license identifier
if you decide to publish.
